plainText:
Battle in Vast Poni Canyon (Japanese: 対決！！ポニのだいきょうこく！ Showdown!! The !) is the 23rd chapter of the of the Pokémon Adventures manga.

==Plot==
 
==Major events==
returns, asking to join Hapu's team. When Hapu refuses and suggests it join , Crabominable reluctantly agrees and is nicknamed Loot.
Hapu reveals she is in possession of the Moon Flute.
Gladion and Lillie head to the Poni Altar, but are attacked by a .
Faba and the s arrive at Vast Poni Canyon and split into two groups: one to capture Hapu, and the other to head to the Poni Altar.
Plumeria confronts Faba, demanding to know where Guzma was taken to.
Plumeria reveals she has the Guzma received from the Aether Foundation, though it has since evolved into a .
and Anabel arrive to confront Faba.
Faba has the Employees battle in his place while he tries to escape.
Nebby and the other Cosmoem fly into the air and meet each other.
